name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd
title: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd - 543257 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: IRFC sanctioned ~INR74,000 cr and disbursed ~INR35,000 cr in FY26 with NIM rising to 1.50%, but gave no numeric FY27 guidance and Q4 PAT was flat on new provisioning.

triggers.label: New-business margin 100-120 bps vs 35-40 bps
triggers.quote: we are able to garner a margin of more than 100 bps

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 guidance given
triggers.quote: On these notes, we are not putting any numbers as a guidance for FY27.

triggers.label: Diversification: 40% non-railway target
triggers.quote: Yes company aspires to have a kind of 30% to 40% mix from the non -railway business.

guidance.quote: we expect that in the FY27, our sanctions should be more than INR75,000 crores
We believe that the mark of INR35,000 crores will be again breached.
we are giving us a target that my NIM for FY27 should grow minimum 10%.

guidance.value: Cross INR5 lakh crore in FY27, likely H1
guidance.quote: we should touch sometime in H1, maybe early to that, let us see.
we should grow in double digit.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we crossed the mark or we reached the mark of nearly INR74,000 crores for the year
against the guidance of INR30,000 crores for disbursement, we could do around INR35,000 crores.
And end of the year, we ended up around 8%.

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT flat; OCI hit from FX hedge MTM
red_flags.quote: Quarter 4 was a little flat or subdued from the fact that there were some provisions to be made

red_flags.label: Non-railway lending shifts to provisioned, higher-risk book
red_flags.quote: Yes, there's a balance sheet and there is a risk

evasions.topic: ROA and tax-adjusted return on new business
evasions.quote: I can give you the indicators. And you have taken all the indicators in the right manner that I can assure you.
On these notes, we are not putting any numbers as a guidance for FY27.
